description: This file contains CMake functions for configuring and installing header-only libraries and package configurations, including handling templates, dependencies, and generating configuration files.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs a header-only library, handling templates, dependencies, and target properties.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs a package configuration file (.pc) with include directories, libraries, and other compile options.
